description: This file contains unit tests for the GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer, which checks that types marked with [GenerateSerializer] have proper [Id] attributes on their fields for Orleans serialization. It uses Xunit for testing and references external analyzers and Roslyn APIs.

classes.name: GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer for various serializable types.

methods.name: VerifyGeneratedDiagnostic
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies that the provided code snippet triggers the expected diagnostic from the analyzer.

methods.description: Test method that checks detection of missing [Id] attribute on a class marked with [GenerateSerializer].

methods.name: SerializableStruct
methods.description: Test method that checks detection of missing [Id] attribute on a struct marked with [GenerateSerializer].

methods.name: SerializableRecord
methods.description: Test method that checks detection of missing [Id] attribute on a record marked with [GenerateSerializer].
